one_x_two.probability_source: synchronized de-vigged 1X2 plus only validated residual context

total_goals.selection_objective: validation Total RPS, then Total LogLoss, then Top1
market_features: O/U2.5 historical when that is all that exists
validated full O/U ladder prospectively when available

exact_score.total_layer_selection_objective: validation Total LogLoss, then Total RPS, then Top1
exact_score.conditional_selection_objective: validation exact-score LogLoss, then Top1, then Top3

context_policy.roster: use only STRICT_CURRENT evidence as residual enhancement; missing context produces no fabricated adjustment
context_policy.manager: use only verified manager/change evidence; missing context produces no fabricated adjustment
context_policy.availability: use only time-valid evidence; otherwise unavailable
context_policy.xg: optional challenger enhancement only after immutable prematch panel passes; never required to keep the base track executable

market_policy.historical_fast100: do not pretend O/U2.5 identifies the full 0-7+ distribution
market_policy.prospective_full_ladder: use validated observed half-goal lines only as constraints on an existing direct total prior

validation_policy.promotion_requires: separate prospective evidence; Fast100 is screening only
